purpose: PatchCore patch-score rendering control for PCDR

field_variants.raw_patch: Native 32x32 nearest-neighbour patch-distance grid with no anomaly-map rendering.
field_variants.resize_roundtrip: Nearest-neighbour 32x32-to-256x256 upsampling followed by the registered bilinear 256x256-to-32x32 projection, without Gaussian smoothing.
field_variants.anomalib_default: Frozen Anomalib anomaly-map generator (32x32-to-256x256 upsampling and sigma-4 smoothing) followed by the registered bilinear 256x256-to-32x32 projection.

invariants: same frozen fold checkpoint and memory bank
same query embeddings and nearest-neighbour patch scores
same 73 crop observations and processed-pixel budget
same robust-z scoring and grouped target evaluation
config.interpretation: A persistent coordinate-centered gain on raw_patch rules out the complete upsample-smooth-downsample chain as a necessary cause. A gain confined to anomalib_default narrows the claim to calibration of the standard Anomalib rendering pipeline.

geometric_fusion.hard_center_tie_rule: equal mean among observations tied for maximum boundary distance

context_response_calibration.score: pattern-conditional empirical upper-tail of one-sided robust residual energy
context_response_calibration.physical_field_estimator: inverse-robust-variance weighted mean after crop-relative median bias removal

ablation_estimators.context_bias_equal_mean: equal mean after crop-relative median bias removal
ablation_estimators.context_scale_weighted_mean: inverse-robust-variance weighted raw response without bias removal
